messages:
Mina: sharing a new iteration of the latency overview panel. main goals: make p95 readable at a glance, keep heatmap and line-chart context, and decide how the timepicker behaves when sampling is toggled. figma: https://figma.com/file/new-latency-iteration (preview)

Zoe: looks tight. quick visual q: should p95 be thicker and slightly translucent so the heatmap still shows through, or full-opaque so its always legible?

Art: thicker + slight translucency sounds good. also add a texture (dashed overlay) option for users with color-vision issues so we dont rely on color alone.

Sam: a11y: agree on non-color cues. legend needs keyboard focus and explicit text alternatives. Also the heatmap color ramp must be tested for deuteranopia and tritanopia.

Mina: where do folks want the color scale? inline under the heatmap for discoverability, or collapsed behind an info icon to save vertical space?

Zoe: inline-bottom is better for discoverability during quick incident triage. collapse rarely used controls into the drawer.

Art: regarding sampling: backend can send header `x-sampled: 1` and `x-sample-rate: 0.08`. UI should show a small, static pill next to the timepicker: "Sampling: 8% (est.)". keep it unobtrusive but visible.

Mina: draft badge copy: "Sampled: 8% (approx)" with tooltip copy: "This view is based on sampled traffic. Metrics are estimated. Turn off sampling for exact counts (costly)." good?

Sam: copy is fine. check contrast for badge and ensure the tooltip is accessible (aria-describedby) and keyboard triggered. Tooltip should be in DOM order after the badge for screen readers.

Zoe: UX: when sampling is on, timepicker presets should stay the same but we should add a small suffix in the preset label, e.g., "1h (samp.)" so users know the view is sampled even after changing ranges.

Art: implementation note: smoothing option needs a flag so we can enable/disable in QA. If smoothing is on, annotate the chart: "Smoothed (10m rolling)" so spikes aren't hidden without explanation. Default: smoothing off.

Mina: proposing front-end config snippet (for the spec PR) as plain text for devs:
```
sampling_enabled: true
badge_text_template: "Sampled: {rate}% (approx)"
timepicker_presets: ["15m","1h","6h","24h"]
legend_position: "inline-bottom"
heatmap_palette: "deuteranopia_safe"
smoothing_default: false
```

Sam: keyboard checklist: badge focusable, tooltip enter/space to open, tooltip content in aria-describedby, preset labels include text hint for sampling, smoothing toggle tabbable and has aria-checked.

Zoe: tiny copy nit: prefer "(approx)" over "(est.)". more readable.

Art: agree. also request an API contract clause in the spec: include sample_rate (float), sampled (bool), smoothing_applied (bool) in response metadata.

DeployBot: preview deployed: https://deploy-preview.internal/latency-panel-1843 includes keyboard nav and contrast report.

Mina: great feedback. I'll update the figma with shaded p95 + texture option, move legend inline-bottom, add the sampling pill mock with the new copy, and add the a11y checklist. tagging eng and QA in the spec PR once it's up.

Zoe: thanks  will review the PR tomorrow.

Sam: :+1: good plan.
